messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected: runtime queue length spike on embeddings pool 'embed-prod-1'. P95 latency >6s, P99 ~12s, error rate climbing for tenant t-cobalt. Auto-alerted at 2026-03-17T14:02:14Z
oncall-ryan: ack — looking now, pulling metrics and recent deploys
alyssa: I'm seeing a jump in small-batch embeddings at 14:00, correlates with a surge from t-cobalt. Queue depth per worker ~18 (target 8).
matt: any config changes deployed in last 30m?
infra-bot: recent deploy: model-quantization-optimizer v3.2 rolled to embed-prod-1 at 13:58 UTC across 4 nodes. No config toggles.
oncall-ryan: ok scope: likely runtime pressure from increased concurrency + new kernel selection. Will attempt live mitigation: reduce max_in_flight for embeddings route, enable soft-shed for long requests, and temporarily throttle t-cobalt.
alyssa: +1. Recommend lowering per-worker concurrency from 8 -> 4 to test impact. Also raise request timeout from 20s -> 30s to avoid hard drops while shedding.
oncall-ryan: doing changes now. Commands: \n```
# reduce max in-flight for embeddings route
./infractl route update --route embeddings --max-inflight 4 --pool embed-prod-1
# enable soft shedding (drop long-running requests after 60s)
./infractl runtime set --pool embed-prod-1 --soft-shed 60s
# throttle tenant t-cobalt to 30 QPM
./infractl tenant throttle --tenant t-cobalt --route embeddings --qpm 30
```
alyssa: running those with you — patching one node at a time to avoid slamming.
matt: tagging @cust-success-june — likely customer-visible degradations for t-cobalt, please prepare a brief.
cust-success-june: on it. I can reach out after we confirm mitigation. What's current error rate?
infra-bot: metrics after change (14:05 UTC): P95 latency -> 3.2s (was ~6s), P99 -> 6.8s (was ~12s), error rate for t-cobalt dropped from 7.4% -> 1.6%. Queue depth per worker trending down to ~7.
oncall-ryan: looks promising. Next: keep throttles for 10m then gradually relax. Also schedule a rollback of model-quantization-optimizer v3.2 if we see recurrence.
product-lina: note: v3.2 included a kernel fallback that increases per-request CPU for short sequences; might reduce throughput. Good catch.
alyssa: I'm going to increase batching threshold to 2 for embeddings to improve throughput: \n```
./infractl route update --route embeddings --batch-min 2 --pool embed-prod-1
```
oncall-ryan: applied. Observing metrics... (14:09 UTC) P99 now 5.1s, tailing down. Errors steady ~1.2%.
cust-success-june: customer update draft: "We've observed a transient slowdown affecting embeddings for your workspace ~14:00 UTC. We've applied temporary throttles and mitigations; latency and errors are back to normal. We'll follow up with a post-incident note." Shall I send?
product-lina: hold for 5 more mins. If stable, send and include note about potential rollback of v3.2.
alyssa: one more small tweak: extend soft-shed to 90s to avoid cascading retries.
noncall-ryan: applied soft-shed 90s.
infra-bot: snapshot after full mitigation (14:14 UTC): P95 2.8s, P99 4.6s, t-cobalt error 0.9%, queue depth stable 6-8.
oncall-ryan: good. Start relaxation: increase t-cobalt QPM from 30 -> 60 in 2 steps (30min apart) if stable. I'll leave the per-worker concurrency at 4 for now and escalate to infra if needed.
matt: filing a follow-up task to investigate v3.2 perf regression and add a model-variant fallback policy.
product-lina: add an eval to catch latency regressions on short sequences for future rollouts.
cust-success-june: sending customer note now. Thanks team.
noncall-ryan: closing incident thread. Postmortem owners: matt (root cause & rollback plan), alyssa (runtime tuning & playbook updates), cust-success-june (customer comms). I'll create the incident ticket and assign.
incident-bot: INCIDENT resolved: runtime queue pressure mitigated. Severity: Sev3. Time to recover: ~12 minutes (14:02 -> 14:14 UTC).
oncall-ryan: quick notes for postmortem: consider autoscaling thresholds for embed-prod-1, add canary for model-quantization-optimizer v3.x that stresses small-batch patterns, and add a safety throttle per-tenant when queue depth >12.
alyssa: agree. I'll draft playbook snippets for "embeddings pool pressure" with exact infractl commands so oncall runbook is explicit.
matt: thanks — attaching logs + metrics to the incident ticket.
cust-success-june: ping if you want me to add customer timeline to the ticket.
product-lina: great work everyone :thumbsup:
